title: Harry Styles Launches Historic 30-Show Residency at Madison Square Garden
text:
Harry Styles began a record-breaking 30-night residency at New York's Madison Square Garden, performing his 'Together, Together' tour with support from DJ-producer Jamie xx. The unique visit saw Styles debut a new song and pay tribute to musical icons.
Harry Styles kicked off an unprecedented 30-night residency at New York's Madison Square Garden on Tuesday, marking the first of many consecutive shows at the iconic venue.
The singer, who has a history with the Garden, began his 'Together, Together' tour in support of his dance-infused February LP. Styles was joined by DJ-producer Jamie xx, who set the tone for the evening with a mix of solo hits, productions, and classics from his band The xx. The New York show was the tour's first and only U.S. stop, following dates in Amsterdam, London, São Paulo, and Mexico City.
Styles greeted fans with a new song and revisited fan favorites, also paying tribute to the late Dolly Parton. The residency will continue through Halloween, by which point the New York Knicks will have played three home games in the 2026-27 NBA regular season
